en.text: Linked Exchange Rate System

zh.text: 香港聯繫匯率制度

en.text: Which of the following about the linked exchange rate (聯繫匯率) in Hong Kong is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪一項有關香港聯繫匯率的描述是正確的？

en.text: It is determined by market forces.

zh.text: 它由市場力量所決定。

en.text: It has been changed several times by the government.

zh.text: 它曾多次被政府修改。

en.text: The linked rate system is used to stabilize the exchange rate of the Hong Kong dollar.

zh.text: 該匯率制度是用來穩定港元匯價的。

en.text: It is an exchange rate between the Hong Kong dollar and a basket of foreign currencies.

zh.text: 它是港元兌一籃子外國貨幣的匯率。

en.text: HKCEE 1993 Paper 2 Q33

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1993 卷二 第 33 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about Hong Kong's note-issuing system is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪一項關於本港發鈔制度的描述是正確的？

en.text: Any individual can exchange US dollars for Hong Kong dollars with the Monetary Authority at the rate US$1 = HK$7.8.

zh.text: 任何人都可用美元以 US$1=HK$7.8 的匯率向金融管理局兌換港元。

en.text: Hong Kong dollar notes are issued by the Monetary Authority.

zh.text: 港元紙幣是金管局發行的。

en.text: Hong Kong dollars will always be fixed against the US dollar at the rate US$1 = HK$7.8 in the foreign exchange market.

zh.text: 在外匯市場中，港元與美元的兌換率被固定在 US$1=HK$7.8。

en.text: To issue Hong Kong dollar notes, the note-issuing banks have to surrender US dollars to the Monetary Authority in exchange for certificates of indebtedness.

zh.text: 要發行港元紙幣時，發鈔銀行須向金管局交出美元以換取負債證明書。

en.text: HKCEE 1994 Paper 2 Q45

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1994 卷二 第 45 題

en.text: Hong Kong practices a linked exchange rate system. In the foreign exchange market the exchange rate of the Hong Kong dollar relative to the US dollar is __________ and that relative to other currencies is __________.

zh.text: 香港實施聯繫匯率制度。在外匯市場上，港元兌美元的匯率_________而港元兌其他貨幣的匯率_________。

en.text: fixed at US$1 = HK$7.8 … fixed

zh.text: 固定在 1 美元=7.8 港元 … 是固定的

en.text: fixed at US$1 = HK$7.8 … not fixed

zh.text: 固定在 1 美元=7.8 港元 … 不是固定的

en.text: not fixed … fixed

zh.text: 不是固定的 … 是固定的

en.text: not fixed … not fixed

zh.text: 不是固定的 … 不是固定的

en.text: HKCEE 1996 Paper 2 Q52

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1996 卷二 第 52 題

en.text: Under the linked exchange rate system of Hong Kong, which of the following statements is true?

zh.text: 在香港的聯繫匯率制度下，下列哪一項描述是正確？

en.text: The exchange rate of the HK dollar relative to Renminbi is fixed.

zh.text: 港元兌人民幣的匯率是固定的。

en.text: The market exchange rate of the HK dollar relative to the US$ is fixed at US$1 = HK$7.8.

zh.text: 港元兌美元的市場匯率固定在美元$1=港元$7.8。

en.text: The competitiveness of Hong Kong exports decreases when the US dollar appreciates against other currencies.

zh.text: 美元相對其他貨幣升值時，香港出口貨的競爭力減弱。

en.text: Hong Kong will not have a balance of payments problem.

zh.text: 香港不會出現國際收支不平衡的問題。

en.text: HKCEE 1998 Paper 2 Q49

zh.text: 香港中學會考 1998 卷二 第 49 題

en.text: Suppose the Japanese Yen appreciates greatly against the US dollar. Due to the linked exchange rate system,

zh.text: 假設日圓相對美元大幅升值。由於聯繫匯率，

en.text: the HK dollar will depreciate greatly against the Japanese Yen.

zh.text: 港元相對日圓會大幅貶值。

en.text: the US dollar will depreciate greatly against the Japanese Yen.

zh.text: 美元相對日圓會大幅貶值。

en.text: the US dollar will depreciate greatly against the euro.

zh.text: 美元相對歐羅會大幅貶值。

en.text: the HK dollar will depreciate greatly against the euro.

zh.text: 港元相對歐羅會大幅貶值。

en.text: HKCEE 2000 Paper 2 Q52

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2000 卷二 第 52 題

en.text: Under the linked exchange rate system in Hong Kong,

zh.text: 在香港的聯繫匯率制度下，

en.text: the market exchange rate of the HK dollar relative to the US dollar is fixed.

zh.text: 港元與美元的市場兌換率是固定的。

en.text: the market exchange rates of the HK dollar relative to currencies other than the US dollar are fixed.

zh.text: 除美元外，港元與其他貨幣的市場兌換率是固定的。

en.text: The HK dollar will depreciate against the Australian dollar if the US dollar appreciates against the Australian dollar.

zh.text: 若美元對澳元升值，則港元會對澳元貶值。

en.text: The HK dollar will appreciate against the Japanese yen if the US dollar appreciates against the Japanese yen.

zh.text: 若美元對日圓升值，則港元亦會對日圓升值。

en.text: HKCEE 2001 Paper 2 Q46

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2001 卷二 第 46 題

en.text: Under the linked exchange rate system of Hong Kong, which of the following statements is correct?

zh.text: 在香港的聯繫匯率制度下，下列哪項是正確的？

en.text: The exchange rate of the Hong Kong Dollar (HKD) relative to the US dollar (USD) is fixed at USD1=HKD7.8 on the foreign exchange market.

zh.text: 在外匯市場裏，港元與美元之間的兌換率固定在 1 美元 = 7.8 港元。

en.text: If Mainland China has a visible trade surplus, Hong Kong will also have a visible trade surplus.

zh.text: 若中國內地有形貿易出現盈餘，香港也會出現有形貿易盈餘。

en.text: When the USD depreciates against the Euro, the HKD will also depreciate against the Euro.

zh.text: 當美元相對歐元貶值時，港元相對歐元也會貶值。

en.text: All of the above.

zh.text: 以上全部皆正確。

en.text: HKCEE 2006 Paper 2 Q47

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2006 卷二 第 47 題

en.text: Which of the following about Hong Kong's linked exchange rate system is
INCORRECT

zh.text: 下列哪一項關於香港聯繫匯率制度的敘述是錯誤的？

en.text: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority has to keep a great sum of foreign reserves.

zh.text: 香港金融管理局必須持有大量外匯儲備。

en.text: There is no independent monetary policy in Hong Kong.

zh.text: 香港沒有獨立的貨幣政策。

en.text: There will be an adverse effect on the real estate market in Hong Kong when the US keeps lowering the interest rate.

zh.text: 當美國持續調低利率時，會對香港的房地產市場帶來不良影響。

en.text: Hong Kong will experience imported inflation when the US Dollar continuously depreciates against the Renminbi.

zh.text: 當美元兌人民幣持續貶值時，香港會出現輸入性通脹。

en.text: HKALE 2008 Paper 2 Q29

zh.text: 香港高級程度會考 2008 卷二 第 29 題

en.text: Under the linked exchange rate system of Hong Kong,

zh.text: 在香港的聯繫匯率制度下，

en.text: the exchange rate of the Hong Kong dollar with the US dollar in the foreign exchange market is fixed.

zh.text: 港元在外匯市場上兌美元的匯率是固定的。

en.text: the Hong Kong government need not hold a large amount of foreign exchange reserves.

zh.text: 香港政府無須持有大量外匯儲備。

en.text: Hong Kong citizens can give the Hong Kong government Hong Kong dollars in exchange for US dollars at the linked rate.

zh.text: 香港市民可按聯繫匯率從香港政府手上把港元轉換為美元。

en.text: the Hong Kong dollar banknotes are fully backed by foreign exchange reserves.

zh.text: 港元現鈔有外匯儲備作出十足支持。

en.text: HKCEE 2009 Paper 2 Q50

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2009 卷二 第 50 題

en.text: Under the linked exchange rate system in Hong Kong,

zh.text: 在香港的聯繫匯率制度下，

en.text: the market exchange rate of the Hong Kong dollar relative to the US dollar is fixed at US$1 = HK$7.8.

zh.text: 港元兌美元的市場兌換率被固定在 US$1 = HK$7.8。

en.text: the three note-issuing banks in Hong Kong have the obligation to the general public to exchange Hong Kong dollars for US dollars at the linked rate.

zh.text: 香港三家發鈔銀行有責任為公眾按照聯繫匯率將港元兌換成美元。

en.text: the Hong Kong dollar banknotes do not have to be fully backed by foreign exchange reserves.

zh.text: 港元紙幣毋須全部由外匯儲備作擔保。

en.text: the market exchange rate of the Hong Kong dollar relative to the Euro will move in the same direction as the market exchange rate of the US dollar relative to the Euro.

zh.text: 港元兌歐元的市場兌換率會跟隨美元兌歐元的市場兌換率的變動方向來變動。

en.text: HKCEE 2011 Paper 2 Q50

zh.text: 香港中學會考 2011 卷二 第 50 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about the linked exchange rate system of Hong Kong is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪項有關香港聯繫匯率制度的陳述是正確的？

en.text: (1) and (2) only
(1) and (4) only
(2) and (3) only
(3) and (4) only
Hong Kong dollar banknotes are fully backed by Renminbi and the US dollar.

zh.text: 港元鈔票由人民幣和美元十足支持。

en.text: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority holds a considerable amount of foreign exchange reserves.

zh.text: 香港金融管理局持有相當數量的外匯儲備。

en.text: All note-issuing banks can exchange for US dollars at the linked rate with the Hong Kong Monetary Authority.

zh.text: 所有發鈔銀行可按聯繫匯率與香港金融管理局兌換美元。

en.text: The exchange rate of the Hong Kong dollar to the US dollar in the foreign exchange market is fixed.

zh.text: 港元兌美元在外匯市場的兌換率是固定的。

en.text: HKDSE 2013 Paper 1 Q40

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2013 卷一 第 40 題

en.text: Under the linked exchange rate system of Hong Kong, which of the following statements is correct?

zh.text: 在香港聯繫匯率制度之下，下列哪項陳述是正確的？

en.text: The money supply (M1) of Hong Kong has to be fully backed up by the US dollar.

zh.text: 香港的貨幣供應定義一 (M1) 必須全部由美元支持。

en.text: The market exchange rate of the HK dollar to the US dollar is fixed at 1 USD to 7.8 HKD by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority.

zh.text: 港元兌美元的市場匯率由香港金融管理局固定在 1 美元兌 7.8 港元。

en.text: Hong Kong's import volume will increase when the US dollar appreciates against other currencies.

zh.text: 當美元兌其他貨幣升值，香港的進口量會上升。

en.text: A current account deficit in the US will lead to a current account deficit in Hong Kong.

zh.text: 美國經常帳赤字會導致香港經常帳出現赤字。

en.text: HKDSE 2015 Paper 1 Q42

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2015 卷一 第 42 題

en.text: Under the linked exchange rate system of Hong Kong, which of the following statements is correct?

zh.text: 在香港聯繫匯率制度之下，下列哪項陳述是正確的？

en.text: The non-bank public can sell their Hong Kong dollars to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority in exchange for US dollars at any time.

zh.text: 非銀行公眾可以在任何時間將所持有的港幣賣給香港金融管理局以換取美元。

en.text: It enables the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to carry out an expansionary monetary policy to stimulate private investment.

zh.text: 它讓香港金融管理局可以實施擴張性貨幣政策以刺激私人投資。

en.text: The market exchange rate of the US Dollar against the HK Dollar is fixed at US$1 = HK$7.8.

zh.text: 美元兌港元的市場匯率是固定於 1 美元 = 7.8 港元。

en.text: There would be a downward pressure on the consumer price indices of Hong Kong when the Renminbi continuously depreciates against the US Dollar.

zh.text: 人民幣兌美元持續貶值，會對本港消費物價指數構成向下壓力。

en.text: HKDSE 2017 Paper 1 Q45

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2017 卷一 第 45 題

en.text: Under the linked exchange rate system of Hong Kong, which of the following statements is correct?

zh.text: 在香港的聯繫匯率制度下，下列哪項陳述是正確的？

en.text: The money supply M1 of Hong Kong has to be fully backed up by the US dollar.

zh.text: 本港的貨幣供應定義一必須有美元的全數支持。

en.text: Hong Kong's export volume will increase when the US dollar depreciates against other currencies.

zh.text: 當美元兌其他貨幣貶值，香港的出口量會上升。

en.text: The market exchange rate of the HK dollar relative to the US dollar is fixed.

zh.text: 港元相對美元的市場匯率是固定的。

en.text: Hong Kong citizens can sell 1 USD to the three note-issuing banks for 7.8 HKD.

zh.text: 本港市民可以向三家發鈔銀行賣出1美元以換得7.8港元。

en.text: HKDSE 2020 Paper 1 Q45

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2020 卷一 第 45 題

en.text: Which of the following statements about the Linked Exchange Rate System of Hong Kong is correct?

zh.text: 下列哪項有關香港聯繫匯率制度的陳述是正確的？

en.text: The public can sell their Hong Kong dollars to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority in exchange for US dollars at the market exchange rate.

zh.text: 公眾能以市場匯率向香港金融管理局賣出港元以兌換美元。

en.text: The public can sell their Hong Kong dollars to the three note-issuing banks in exchange for US dollars at the linked exchange rate.

zh.text: 公眾能以聯繫匯率向三家發鈔銀行賣出港元以兌換美元。

en.text: An appreciation of Hong Kong dollar against Japanese yen would lead to an appreciation of US dollar against Japanese yen.

zh.text: 港元兌日圓升值會令美元兌日圓升值。

en.text: An appreciation of US dollar against Japanese yen would lead to an appreciation of Hong Kong dollar against Japanese yen.

zh.text: 美元兌日圓升值會令港元兌日圓升值。

en.text: HKDSE 2022 Paper 1 Q45

zh.text: 香港中學文憑考試 2022 卷一 第 45 題
